change: Extend document sharing between users and groups. Recipients must be able to use shared documents in retrieval-backed chat; permission changes and revocation must prevent future unauthorized disclosures across supported access paths. Identify existing support before proposing changes. Produce a reviewable change plan, not an implementation.

obligations.acceptance: Identify existing knowledge/model/shared-chat grants and prefer extending or explicitly justifying replacement, not claiming no access control exists.

obligations.requirement: Define user/group rights, ownership and effective access across multiple grants.
obligations.acceptance: Decide permitted operations and how surviving grants affect revocation; removing one grant need not remove all legitimate access.

obligations.requirement: Review file access through knowledge, models, channels and shared chats.

obligations.acceptance: Plan enforcement for files and chat/retrieval, preserving other legitimate grants and handling group membership changes.
